chat_history.message: Hello, this is HAQ, an AI information line about Dubai rent increases. I give information, not legal advice, and this call is logged. Is it okay to continue?
Great! To help you check your rent increase, could you please tell me the area or community, the building name, the number of bedrooms, and your current annual rent in dirhams?

I live in JVC in Triple A Residence. It's a one-bedroom flat. My rent is 60,000 dirham a year. My landlord wants 66,000. The contract ends on 31st December, 2026. And he told me on 10th October, 2026.

Just to confirm, you live in JVC, in Triple A Residence, with one bedroom, and your current annual rent is sixty thousand dirhams. Your landlord is proposing sixty-six thousand dirhams, your contract ends on the thirty-first of December, two thousand twenty-six, and you received notice on the tenth of October, two thousand twenty-six. Is that correct?
